front: How does gold panning affect rivers?
back: Silt increases turbidity, reducing light and photosynthesis and smothering invertebrates; mercury pollutes and bioaccumulates.
Build-up of a persistent substance in tissues, increasing along food chains (highest in top carnivores).
Extra CO₂, CH₄ and N₂O absorb infrared radiation from the Earth, warming the lower atmosphere.
Mats block light and gas exchange; dead plants decompose, using oxygen; blocks boats, intakes and canals.
Sulfide minerals in mine waste are oxidised to sulfuric acid, lowering stream pH and dissolving toxic metals.

front: Three methods of controlling invasive plants
back: Mechanical removal; herbicides; biological control with a tested, host-specific natural enemy.
